title: Existence of an integral basis for a finite extension of local coefficient fields
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime and let $E\subseteq F$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], with the compatible absolute values extending the $\ell$-adic absolute value. Put $\mathcal O_E=\{x\in E:|x|\leq1\}$ and $\mathcal O_F=\{x\in F:|x|\leq1\}$, the rings of integers, with the inclusion induced by $E\subseteq F$. Let $d=[F:E]=\dim_E F$. There exist elements $b_1,\ldots,b_d\in\mathcal O_F$ such that every $x\in\mathcal O_F$ has a unique expression $x=\sum_{i=1}^d a_i b_i$ with $a_i\in\mathcal O_E$.

source.place: opening sentence: O_F is a finite torsion-free, hence free, module over the discrete valuation ring O_E, of rank d; the existence part required before applying the basis-induced sheaf comparison

from.place: proof paragraph 3, first sentence: choose an O_E-basis of O_F before condensing and pulling back; algebraic existence is expanded in the opening sentence of sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients-finite-free.proof.md
